Mesha.text: Today brings a sense of renewal as the Moon graces your first house, offering you a fresh perspective on your personal path. You may find yourself feeling more sensitive than usual, yet this clarity allows you to see your own needs with newfound honesty. Chandra moving through your first house is a favourable influence, encouraging you to embrace your authentic self. However, Surya in the fourth house and Guru in the same position suggest that your domestic life or inner peace might feel slightly strained today. Shani moving through your twelfth house pulls your attention inward, reminding you that solitude is often the best teacher. Kuja in the third house is blocked, so try to avoid impulsive communication or hasty decisions regarding your immediate surroundings. Budha in the fourth house is also blocked, which might lead to some misunderstandings in family discussions. Shukra in the sixth house is adverse, suggesting you should be mindful of overextending yourself in service to others. Ketu in the fifth house asks you to detach from rigid expectations regarding your creative projects. Rahu in the eleventh house is favourable, providing a subtle boost to your social connections and long-term aspirations. Please remember that you are currently experiencing the rising phase of Sade Sati, which calls for patience and steady endurance in all matters. Trust that this period of reflection will eventually lead to greater wisdom. Take a deep breath and move through your day with gentle intention.
Mesha.advice: Focus on quiet introspection rather than seeking external validation today.

Ketu in the fourth house is adverse, suggesting you might feel a bit restless within your home environment. Use this time to nurture your inner world rather than forcing external changes. You are capable of navigating these shifts with grace and steady determination.
Vrishabha.advice: Practice mindful speech and prioritize your rest to maintain your inner balance.
